description: Added by review: maximumLocalizedStringsFiles lowered to 1 in a directory holding one loadable file plus four entries discovery skips (an unrecognized name, an unknown language, a hidden tag, a non-tag). Verified: the load SUCCEEDS. LoadingSession.beginLocalizedStringsFile is only reached for files that are actually parsed, so skipped entries cost nothing against the file cap — they are counted separately by maximumDiscoveryEntries, which this corpus's schema cannot express.
